title: 第三百五十章 得罪武王第三百四十九章 反客为主
lines: 第两百五十章：得罪武王
看了眼空旷了许多的客厅，朱易挤出一丝笑容，缓缓的收起软剑，一把抓起刘江洛走进了内堂。而叶重则是拍了拍手，朝严苛笑了笑，也是施施然的也走了进去。
看如此场景，严苛则是长叹了一声，皱眉看了看满地的血肉狼藉，无奈的摇了摇头。他跺跺脚，眼珠转悠了几圈，急忙也跟进了内堂。
内堂是一间陈设华美的小隔间，一切都极尽精致奢侈，两个吞天蟾蜍造型的香炉正喷出淡紫色的香气，浓郁的百合花香味弥漫四周，将前堂传来的血腥气冲刷得干干净净。朱易将刘江洛按倒在一张矮榻上坐定，自己也紧贴着刘江洛坐了下来。
刚刚还缠在刘江洛脖子上的软剑已经被朱易收进了袖子，他右手紧贴着刘江洛的软肋，剑尖刺破了刘江洛的衣服，几乎刺破了刘江洛的皮肤。只要有丝毫变动，朱易真气一吐，软剑就能长驱直入，从软肋直刺刘江洛的心脏。
叶重在刘江洛对面的矮榻上坐下，翘起了二郎腿，笑呵呵的抖着身体，眯着眼打量着面色惨白的刘江洛。严苛临时充当了仆役的角色，从常备在内堂角落里的小火炉上，端起一个白铜暖壶沏了一壶茶，给在场的每人都倒了一杯热茶。
脖子上血流了一大片，上半身衣服被血迹染得一片狼藉的刘江洛，哆哆嗦嗦的端起茶盏，也不顾茶水滚烫，仰起脖子就将一盏茶喝得干干净净。长舒了一口气，滚烫的茶水似乎给他带去了一点点热量，刘江洛的脸色逐渐的恢复了一丝红晕。
双手端着茶盏，把玩着茶盏盖子，叶重斜眼看着刘江洛冷笑道：“说吧，武王殿下，您怎么没事跑来我们公子府上，好像是一门心思来欺负人呢？说爵位，您是王爵，说辈分，您是长辈，说权势，您是大汉朝当今负责朝政的八王之一。您有必要为了几座铁山，闹成这样子吗？”。
刘江洛目光复杂的看了叶重一眼，差点没破口大骂出来。
至于闹成这样子么？以他刘江洛的身份地位，他不要说用渔场、珠场和玉矿交换那几座铁山，他就算是开口白拿，大汉朝有几个人敢不卖他面子？就算是刘戈那个吝啬鬼，他刘江洛如果想要从刘戈手上弄几条矿脉什么的，刘戈也最多最多要求一个等价交换而已。
朱易只是一个初入长安，没有丝毫根基，没有半点儿权势，空有虚名的公爵！刘江洛亲自出面和他交换产业，已经给了他天大的面子，事情何以演变成这样子？
其实，刘江洛不过是想要给朱易一个下马威，活活打死他的门客，让朱易乖乖的听话而已。他武王刘江洛打死几个人，这不是稀松平常的事情？叶重为什么要有这么激烈的反应？朱易又何必为了区区一个门客，居然对自己这个督抚朝政的八王之一动刀子呢？
苦笑了一声，刘江洛低声叹道：“何必这样呢？本王并没有和左国正交恶的意思啊？”。
叶重笑了笑，接着却是冷声道：“您没有和我们家公子交恶的意思，但是您下令打死我！”。
从锦囊中取出一柄锋利的小匕首，将茶盏放在矮榻上，慢条斯理的修理起指甲，叶重很不自谦的说道：“叶重不才，虽然挂着我们公子首席门客的身份，但是和我们公子，是兄弟一样的交情。您当着我们公子的面要打死我，这是不给我们公子面子。既然你不给我们公子面子，我干嘛给你面子？”
朱易笑了，笑得很灿烂，他蕴藏了深厚感情的望了叶重一眼，右手微微一顶，剑锋刺入刘江洛皮肉三分，一缕鲜血顺着刘江洛的皮肤缓缓滑下，刘江洛刚刚恢复一点的脸色又变得难看起来。
轻叹了一口气，叶重摇头道：“如果我们杀了督抚八王之一的武王，那么只要带着他的人头逃去那些蛮人控制的地盘，想必我们能混得不错？蛮人的女人生得很水灵，吃喝用度，样样也不比大汉朝差到哪里去。穷极无聊了，就带几个蛮人走出山林杀杀人，抢抢地盘，也是逍遥快活啊！”。
闻言，武王则是苦笑道：“投靠蛮人？他们不会信任你们的。”。
叶重冷笑道：“都说了，用你的人头开路，堂堂大汉朝督抚八王之一的人头，他们信还是不信？或者，干脆我们带着你的活口去投奔蛮人，有你的口供，他们总该信了吧？”。
武王的脸色顿时一变，他张了张嘴，硬是没能吭声。他算是知道了，叶重就是一个亡命之徒，一个真正的亡命之徒，他做出什么事情都不稀奇。真要带着他刘江洛的人头去投奔蛮人，那些蛮人一定会欢天喜地的接纳他们。
就算他们不去投奔蛮人，大汉朝疆土广大，这么多的诸侯国，叶重他们宰了刘江洛后，只要逃出长安，哪里不能容身？
想到厉害处，刘江洛不由得苦笑起来：“本王这次真不该来，这是何苦来由？白白死伤了这么多心腹甲士，还有好容易才招揽的两个供奉。真是，何苦来？”。
严苛冷哼一声，便是朝刘江洛拱手一礼，而后沉声道：“武王这次，是为谁来和左国正谈条件？”。
望了严苛一眼，刘江洛苦声道：“这次，也是本王新纳的侧妃求本王求得苦了。她的兄长看上了左国正封地内的七座铁山和五处炼铁场，所以才求了本王，用那几处渔场、珠场和玉矿来交换。只是没想到，本王居然吃了这么大的苦头。”。
刘江洛新纳的侧妃的兄长，看中了朱易封地上的产业？
叶重和严苛对视了一眼，两人的嘴角同时扯了扯，露出了一丝若有所思的冷笑。
叶重淡然问道：“武王殿下那位新纳的侧妃，是什么来头啊？”。
刘江洛呆了呆，他面皮一抽，语声冰冷的说道：“她是天蛮国血蛮君之女。嘿，嘿，天蛮国？天蛮国的质子，前天夜里，不是因为左国正的关系惨死么？本王被人当刀使了？好大的胆子！”。
刘江洛气急败坏，要不是剑锋顶着他的软肋，他差点就跳起来放声咒骂了。
叶重看了严苛一眼，严苛一声不吭的转身出了内堂。不多时，外面传来了清晰的罡气的波动，还隐隐有破风青狼的狼啸声传出。一会儿的功夫，严苛又转回了内堂，他已经派遣属下，将这里的事情赶去通知给了巡风司。
叶重看着身上到处都是血迹的刘江洛，沉吟了许久，这才长叹道：“您毕竟是大汉的王爵，杀了您，我们是不敢的。但是就这么放您走，我们也是不敢的。督抚八王之一，要找我们公子的麻烦，实在是太麻烦了。”。
不等刘江洛开口，叶重就跳了起来，亲热的紧贴着刘江洛坐下。他搂着刘江洛的肩膀，笑呵呵的说道：“不如这样，您用最狠毒的本命魂魄誓言，发下血誓吧。只要您对我们公子，还有我们公子身边的任何人有了丝毫的报复的念头或者举动，您就死无葬身之地，死后被千万牲口分食，魂魄永世不得超生，而且断子绝孙，就连您这一宗的所有刘氏族人也都不得好死，怎么样？”
刘江洛犹如见鬼一样望着叶重，朱易和严苛的脸色也变得无比的古怪。而叶重则是笑呵呵的看着刘江洛，手上匕首突然狠狠的扎进了刘江洛的大腿。
“不发誓，我可就以为武王殿下您，日后一定要找我们报复，那，就怪不得今天您走不出左国正府了！”
拎着匕首在刘江洛的大腿肌肉里狠狠的转了几圈，刘江洛痛得失声惨叫起来。
无奈何，刘江洛只能一个字一个字的学着叶重的话，发下了这无比狠毒的誓言。
叶重只恨现在修为不够，如果他有了武皇期的修为，就能夺取刘江洛的元神，发下本命元神誓言，这才是最安全的做法。但是现在，只能小心防范，以及寄希望于刘江洛的誓言对他的约束力了。
一刻钟后，更换了全身衣物，脸色无比难看的刘江洛离开了左国正府。
刚出府门，刘江洛就咬牙切齿的下令道：“处死香妃，把她兄长乱棍打死！”。
叶重站在左国正府门口，听着刘江洛下达的命令，只是一阵阵的冷笑。
打发走了武王刘江洛，接下来半个月风平浪静，再没发生一些乱七八糟的事情。

Chapter 250: Offending King Wu
Looking at the much empty living room, Zhu Yi forced out a smile, slowly put away the soft sword, grabbed Liu Jiangluo and walked into the inner hall. Ye Zhong clapped his hands, smiled at Yan Yan, and Shi Shiran also walked in.
Seeing such a scene, Yan Yan let out a long sigh, frowned at the mess of blood and flesh on the ground, and shook his head helplessly. He stamped his feet, rolled his eyes around a few times, and hurriedly followed into the inner hall.
The inner hall is a small cubicle with gorgeous furnishings. Everything is extremely exquisite and luxurious. Two incense burners in the shape of a sky-swallowing toad are emitting a lavender aroma. The rich fragrance of lilies permeates the surroundings, washing away the bloody smell coming from the front hall. Zhu Yi pushed Liu Jiangluo down on a low couch and sat down next to Liu Jiangluo himself.
The soft sword that was still wrapped around Liu Jiangluo's neck just now had been put into Zhu Yi's sleeve. His right hand was close to Liu Jiangluo's soft ribs. The tip of the sword pierced Liu Jiangluo's clothes and almost pierced Liu Jiangluo's skin. As long as there is the slightest change, Zhu Yi exhales his true energy, and the soft sword can drive straight in and pierce Liu Jiangluo's heart from his weak side.
Ye Zhong sat down on the low couch opposite Liu Jiangluo, crossed his legs, shook his body with a smile, and looked at the pale Liu Jiangluo with squinted eyes. Yan Yan temporarily acted as a servant, picked up a white copper thermos from the small stove in the corner of the inner hall, brewed a pot of tea, and poured a cup of hot tea for everyone present.
Liu Jiangluo, who had a large amount of blood on his neck and his upper body clothes stained with blood, tremblingly picked up the tea cup, raised his neck and drank the tea cleanly, regardless of how hot the tea was. He breathed a long sigh of relief. The scalding tea seemed to bring a little bit of heat to him, and Liu Jiangluo's face gradually regained its blush.
Holding the tea cup with both hands and playing with the tea cup lid, Ye Zhong looked sideways at Liu Jiangluo and sneered: "Tell me, Your Highness King Wu, why do you come to our young master's house for nothing, as if you only want to bully others? When it comes to title, you are a prince, when it comes to seniority, you are the elder, and when it comes to power, you are one of the eight kings in charge of government affairs in the Han Dynasty. Do you have to make such a fuss over a few iron mountains?"
Liu Jiangluo glanced at Ye Zhong with complicated eyes and almost cursed.
As for what happened? With Liu Jiangluo's status, let alone exchanging the fishing grounds, pearl farms and jade mines for those iron mountains, even if he just got it for free, how many people in the Han Dynasty would dare not to give him face? Even if Liu Ge is a miser, if Liu Jiangluo wants to get a few mineral veins from Liu Ge, Liu Ge will only ask for an equal exchange at most.
Zhu Yi is just a duke who has just entered Chang'an, without any foundation, without any power, and with no reputation! Liu Jiangluo personally came forward to exchange property with him, which gave him a huge face. How did things turn into this?
In fact, Liu Jiangluo just wanted to give Zhu Yi a warning and beat his retainers to death so that Zhu Yi would obey his orders. Liu Jiangluo, King of Wu, killed several people. Isn't this an ordinary thing? Why did Ye Chong react so violently? Why would Zhu Yi actually use the knife on himself, one of the eight kings who oversees the government, just for a mere retainer?
With a bitter smile, Liu Jiangluo sighed in a low voice: "Why is this necessary? I have no intention of antagonizing Zuo Guozheng?".
Ye Chong smiled, and then said in a cold voice: "You have no intention of antagonizing our young master, but you ordered me to be beaten to death!".
He took out a sharp little dagger from the brocade bag, placed the tea cup on the low couch, and slowly repaired his nails. Ye Zhong said in a very unconcealed voice: "Ye Zhong is not talented. Although he is the chief retainer of our young master, he and our young master are the same as brothers. You want to beat me to death in front of our young master, which is not giving our young master face. Since you don't give our young master face, why should I give you face?"
Zhu Yi smiled brightly. He glanced at Ye Zhong with deep emotion, raised his right hand slightly, and penetrated three points of Liu Jiangluo's flesh with the sword edge. A wisp of blood slowly slid down Liu Jiangluo's skin. Liu Jiangluo's face, which had just recovered a little, became ugly again.
Sighing softly, Ye Zhong shook his head and said: "If we kill King Wu, one of the eight governors, then as long as we take his head and escape to the territories controlled by the barbarians, we will be able to do well. Barbarian women are very lively, and their food and drink expenses are not much worse than those of the Han Dynasty. When we are extremely bored, we take a few barbarians out of the mountains and forests to kill people and grab territory. It is also a happy life!"
Hearing this, King Wu smiled bitterly and said: "Take refuge in the barbarians? They won't trust you.".
Ye Chong sneered and said: "I have already said that I will use your head to clear the way. The head of one of the eight governors of the Han Dynasty. Do they believe it or not? Or, why don't we take your body alive and surrender to the barbarians? With your confession, they should believe it, right?"
King Wu's expression suddenly changed. He opened his mouth but couldn't say anything. He finally knew that Ye Chong was a desperado, a true desperado, and nothing he did was unusual. If they really want to take Liu Jiangluo's head to join the barbarians, those barbarians will definitely accept them happily.
Even if they don't go to the barbarians, the Han Dynasty has a vast territory and there are so many vassal states. After Ye Zhong and others killed Liu Jiangluo, as long as they escaped from Chang'an, where could they not find shelter?
Thinking of the awesomeness, Liu Jiangluo couldn't help but smile bitterly: "I really shouldn't have come this time. Why did I bother to come? So many close soldiers were killed and wounded in vain, and there were still two sacrifices that I had to recruit with great difficulty. Really, why bother to come?"
Yan Yan snorted coldly, bowed his hand to Liu Jiangluo, and then said in a deep voice: "For whom does King Wu come to negotiate terms with Zuo Guozheng this time?".
After giving a stern look, Liu Jiangluo said bitterly: "This time, it was also my king Xinna's concubine who begged me to suffer. Her brother was interested in the seven iron mountains and five iron smelting fields in the Zuo Guozheng fiefdom, so he begged me and used those fisheries, pearl farms and jade mines in exchange. But I didn't expect that I would suffer so much."
The brother of Liu Jiang Luo Xina's concubine, is interested in Zhu Yi's property?
Ye Chong and Yan Yan looked at each other, and the corners of their mouths twitched at the same time, revealing a thoughtful sneer.
Ye Zhong asked calmly: "What is the background of His Highness King Wu's new concubine?".
Liu Jiangluo was stunned. His face twitched and he said in a cold voice: "She is the daughter of the Blood Barbarian Lord of the Tianman Kingdom. Hey, hey, Tianman Kingdom? Didn't the proton of the Tianman Kingdom die tragically because of Zuo Guozheng the night before yesterday? I was used as a knife? How brave!"
Liu Jiangluo was furious. If the sword hadn't been pressed against his weak spot, he would have almost jumped up and cursed loudly.
Ye Zhong glanced at Yan Yan, then turned around and left the inner hall without saying a word. Not long after, clear fluctuations of Gang Qi were heard outside, and the faint howl of the Po Feng Green Wolf could be heard. After a while, Yan Yan returned to the inner hall. He had already sent his subordinates to inform the patrol department about what happened here.
Ye Zhong looked at Liu Jiangluo, who had blood stains all over his body, and pondered for a long time before sighing: "After all, you are the prince of the Han Dynasty. We don't dare to kill you. But we don't dare to let you go like this. It is too troublesome for one of the eight governors to cause trouble for our young master."
Before Liu Jiangluo could speak, Ye Zhong jumped up and sat down close to Liu Jiangluo affectionately. He put his arm around Liu Jiangluo's shoulders and said with a smile: "How about this? You swear a blood oath with the most vicious oath of your soul and soul. As long as you have the slightest thought or action of revenge against our young master and anyone around our young master, you will die without a burial place and be eaten by thousands of animals after your death. Your soul will never be reborn, and you will have no descendants. Even all the Liu clan members of your sect will not have a good death. How about it?"
Liu Jiangluo looked at Ye Chong as if he had seen a ghost, and Zhu Yihe Yan Yan's expressions became extremely strange. Ye Zhong looked at Liu Jiangluo with a smile, and suddenly the dagger in his hand pierced Liu Jiangluo's thigh.
"If I don't swear, I would just think that Your Highness King Wu will seek revenge from us in the future. Then, no wonder you can't leave Zuo Guozheng Mansion today!"
He took the dagger and turned it around in Liu Jiangluo's thigh muscles several times, causing Liu Jiangluo to scream in pain.
Helpless, Liu Jiangluo could only imitate Ye Zhong's words word for word, and swore this extremely vicious oath.
Ye Zhong only regrets that his current cultivation level is not enough. If he has the cultivation level of the Emperor Wu, he can seize Liu Jiangluo's soul and take the oath of his own soul. This is the safest way. But now, he can only take precautions and hope that Liu Jiangluo's oath will bind him.
A quarter of an hour later, Liu Jiangluo, who had changed all his clothes and looked extremely ugly, left Zuo Guozheng Mansion.
As soon as he left the house, Liu Jiangluo gritted his teeth and ordered: "Execute Concubine Xiang and beat her brother to death with sticks!".
Ye Zhong stood at the door of Zuo Guozheng Mansion, listening to Liu Jiangluo's orders and just sneered.
After Wu King Liu Jiangluo was sent away, the next half month was calm and no messy things happened.
